name: Hashly
description: Browser-based hash calculator supporting 30 algorithms: MD2, MD4, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA3-224/256/384/512, BLAKE2b-256/512, BLAKE2s-128/256, BLAKE3-256/512, Keccak-224/256/384/512, RIPEMD-128/160/256/320, and xxHash32/64/3/128. All computation is local — no data is transmitted.
headline: Online Hash Calculator
featureList: MD5 hashing, SHA-256 hashing, BLAKE3 hashing, BLAKE2 hashing, Keccak-256 hashing, RIPEMD-160 hashing, xxHash checksums, 30 hash algorithms, Text hashing, File hashing, Hex output, Base64 output, Binary output, Hash history, Random hash generation
